site.name: Jackson Bethune
site.headline: Building at the intersection of hardware and software.
site.intro: I'm Jackson Bethune, a computer engineering student interested in robotics, embedded systems, digital hardware, and practical engineering design.
site.about: I'm studying Computer Engineering at Louisiana State University. I enjoy solving problems that cross disciplines—from writing robot control software to designing physical systems and working with digital logic.
site.about2: My experience includes FTC robotics programming and design leadership, FPGA coursework, power electronics, and Formula SAE CAD work.
site.skills: Verilog, KiCad, SolidWorks, Robotics, Digital Logic, PCB Design
site.contact: I am interested in internship opportunities in computer and electrical engineering.
